# MediaSet agent instructions

Read and follow [.github/instructions/shared.md](instructions/shared.md)
before working. It owns project policy, workflow, commit/signing requirements,
language-specific instructions, and development/testing references.

See [Development/AGENT_SETUP.md](../Development/AGENT_SETUP.md) for Linux onboarding and the
current hook migration status. Personal tools and integrations are optional.
Copilot follows shared policy; it has no separate project hook implementation.
